jobs.title: Senior Environmental Specialist - Recycling
jobs.description:
**Definition**
--------------


**Applications must be filled out** **completely and thoroughly****. Resumes are not accepted in lieu of an application, but may be additionally attached.**

**PLEASE ATTACH ANY DEGREES OR TRANSCRIPTS, LICENSES, AND CERTIFICATIONS TO YOUR APPLICATION.**  

Anchored in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada \- 20 miles east of Sacramento and about 1\.5 hours from Lake Tahoe \- the City of Folsom is comprised of beautiful parks and trails, and boasts excellent schools, family\-orientated neighborhoods, and outstanding shopping, dining, and cultural options. Folsom is a high\-tech, forward\-looking city, with firms ranging from small to large international corporations. Voted by WalletHub as the Best Place for Families to Live in California, and 2nd Best Lake Town in America, Folsom is recognized for its affordability, fair weather, education, and health.  


\-  

The City of Folsom is recruiting for a **Senior Environmental Specialist** to join the **Waste \& Recycling Division in the specialty area of recycling**. This position will focus on recycling compliance programs relating to non\-hazardous materials and will spend a majority of time providing technical assistance, inspections, and enforcement within the community, including program development and record keeping. The ideal candidate enjoys a variety of work environments and tasks, including physical outdoor labor, an office environment, and regular interaction with the public.  

*This is a Monday \- Friday in\-office position, and occasional weekend and after hours work.* *This position is non\-exempt and represented by the Local 39 IUOE union.*  

Under the direction of the **Environmental Specialist Supervisor**, the **Senior Environmental Specialist** performs a variety of operational tasks (program management, educational training, safety awareness, and environmental compliance and audits) related to environmental services in a specialty area (recycling, hazardous waste, air pollution and storm water compliance). Incumbents may oversee, monitor ,and/or direct the work of lower level personnel.

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**  

The Senior Environmental Specialist is the lead or specialist level in the Environmental Specialist series. In the lead assignment, incumbents provide direction to lower level staff including assigning, directing, and reviewing the work of staff. In the specialist assignment, incumbents work on specialized projects containing a high number of complex, difficult, and sensitive tasks and assignments. Positions at this level are distinguished from those in the lower level classification of Environmental Specialist I/II by the independence with which they perform their duties of handling the more difficult and complex work and performing lead work. This class is distinguished from the class of Environmental Specialist Supervisor in that the latter serves as the supervisor of incumbents in the lower levels of the series and performs the most difficult and complex projects.
**Examples of Essential Duties**
--------------------------------


**NOTE: The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Each individual in the classification does not necessarily perform all the duties listed.**

  

* Assign and monitor the work of lower level staff within the series.
* Develop environmental program designs and operating procedures according to federal and state laws and regulations.
* Provide technical assistance to staff in the development, implementation, and management of residential and commercial recycling programs; edible food recovery; household hazardous waste management programs; and/or storm water and air pollution prevention programs.
* Prepare and submit grant applications and, if awarded, oversee grant implementation and administration, and prepare grant progress reports.
* Assist in the budget development process and administer the respective program's budget.
* Prepare innovative educational and outreach material including flyers, brochures, presentations, displays, news articles, and social media posts.
* Provide information to members of the public, contractors, and consultants regarding hazardous materials, recycling, organics, and food recovery regulations and recycling programs; serve as a resource to city staff regarding proper handling and management of all manners of recyclable materials, organics and food recovery, hazardous and non\-hazardous materials.
* Develop request for proposals for division services, including soliciting suppliers, reviewing proposals, making selection recommendations, and overseeing contracts.
* Compile and analyze data to prepare reports, including state required reports.
* Prepare business correspondence.
* Perform related duties as assigned.

**Employment Standards**
------------------------


**NOTE:** **The level and scope of the following knowledge and abilities are related to duties listed under the "Examples of Essential Duties" section of this specification.**  

  

**Knowledge of:**

* And experience with, composting, including the ability to develop and implement a municipal compost program, and provide educational programs on the subject.
* Methods and procedures used in inspecting, identifying, labeling, packaging, and correcting hazardous conditions associated with hazardous materials or wastes.
* Hazardous material, industrial hygiene, transportation, and disposal practices.
* Principles and practices of emergency preparedness.
* Effects of hazardous materials and their interaction with human health and the environment.
* Recycling techniques as related to the environment, energy conservation, and the economy.
* Laws, codes, regulations, and policies and ability to stay abreast of those that affect the City’s programs.
* Residential municipal, commercial, and industrial waste recycling and disposal programs.

jobs.title: Environmental Science Tutor
jobs.description:
AR Academics, Orange County's premier test preparation and tutoring company, is seeking part\-time environmental science tutors. AR specializes in test preparation, as well as academic subject tutoring for middle school, high school, college, and graduate students.

**POSITION:**

1\-on\-1 Academic Environmental Science Tutoring (Part Time Available)

**WHY TUTOR WITH US?**

\- Freedom to design your own schedule

\- All sessions are 1 on 1 sessions in our office, so no traveling from student to student.

\- We have the ability to book you back to back for extended times to maximize your earnings

\- Paid training and custom designed curriculum for students

\- Opportunities for raises

**COMPENSATION**

We start at anywhere in the range from $25\-$35 per hour depending on experience.

**JOB DESCRIPTION AND FUNCTIONS:**

\- 1\-on\-1 environmental science tutoring for high school level students (regular and AP level)

\- Sessions are usually booked in 1 hour blocks with each tutor and student getting their own private room.

\- Tutor is a coach and mentor, not just someone who will go through each of the questions with a student.

\- Tutor will provide regular progress updates for students.

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

Required:

\- Passion for teaching and working with students

\- Strong interpersonal skills that will help create a safe and fun environment for students (charisma, warmth, relatability, positivity, etc.)

\- Strong background in relevant fields

\- Punctual and reliable transportation

Desired/Strongly preferred:

\- Prior teaching/tutoring experience

\- Advanced knowledge in relevant fields

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Teaching: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an experienced and driven **Client Account Manager \- Air Quality focused** with expertise in air quality compliance (permitting, stack testing, ambient air monitoring) and account management to support business growth and client engagement. This role is ideal for a proven sales leader with an existing book of clients, strong relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of air quality strategies. The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing new business opportunities, driving revenue growth, and delivering innovative environmental solutions.


This hybrid position can be based out of AECOM's offices in Houston, TX; Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; Cincinnati, OH; Denver, CO; Fort Collins, CO; Minneapolis, MN; or Orange, CA. We are also open to candidates not located in these areas, however, must be located within the Western Region of the United States.

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Develop and execute business strategies to expand AECOM’s air quality compliance services.
* Maintain and grow existing client relationships while identifying new opportunities in the public and private sectors.
* Leverage an existing book of clients to generate sales and secure high\-value environmental projects.
* Work closely with internal teams to develop and present proposals, technical solutions, and service offerings.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements to align with client needs and financial objectives.
* Provide industry insight and stay updated on air quality regulations, compliance standards, and emerging trends.
* Support cross\-business collaboration to provide integrated environmental solutions across multiple sectors.
* Meet or exceed sales targets while contributing to the long\-term strategic vision of AECOM.

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, engineering, business, or related field.
* 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in managing client accounts, sales and drive business development within air quality compliance services.
* Travel of 25\-50% will be required, as this is a client facing role.
* Valid US Driver's License and pre\-employment driving record verification are required.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree is preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in account management, sales, and air quality compliance services.
* Proven ability to manage client accounts and drive business development initiatives.
* Strong understanding of air quality regulations, permitting, and compliance.
* Experience leading large\-scale environmental compliance projects.
* Established industry relationships with clients in government, energy, commercial, and industrial sectors.
* Experience in contract negotiations, sales forecasting, and revenue management.
* Ability to work in a matrixed organization, coordinating across multiple teams and disciplines.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, data analytics, and sales tracking platforms.

jobs.title: Scientist Ecotoxicology
jobs.description:
**Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water****Reference number**
552626**Occupation**
Environmental Science**Work type**
Full\-Time**Location**
Lidcombe**Salary Information**
From AUD $110,000\.00 to $119,999\.00 per year**Closing date**
13 September 2026 at 11:55pm
  
***Do you want your work to make a difference for NSW?***  

*Working to protect the state’s environment and heritage.*  

* **Protect NSW's environment through science**
* **Permanent full\-time opportunity, 35 hours per week**
* **Lidcombe office, hybrid working supported**
* **Salary relative to experience, and ranges from $112,375 to $124,158 pa \+ super**

  


Join a passionate team of scientists making a significant impact on environmental protection! Our Science and Insights team is seeking to appoint a Scientist (Ecotoxicology). This is your chance to apply your expertise to important scientific programs and projects and engage in meaningful work that addresses pressing ecotoxicological issues.  

  

**About the role**  

As a Scientist (Ecotoxicology), you will contribute to the design, delivery and analysis of ecotoxicology projects that inform environmental decision\-making and regulation. Working alongside experienced scientists and technical experts, you will support investigations into environmental incidents and research programs, perform ecotoxicity testing, analyse and interpret ecotoxicological data, prepare scientific reports and presentations and collaborate with government agencies, research institutions and other stakeholders to deliver high\-quality environmental outcomes.  

  

The Ecotoxicology team collaborates closely with the Chemical Forensics team, together forming the Environmental Forensics Unit. The role of the Environmental Forensics Unit is to investigate pollution incidents, provide expert advice, and conduct research to protect the New South Wales community, economy and environment from the risk posed by current and legacy environmental contaminants.  

  

This is an exciting opportunity to apply your scientific expertise to real\-world environmental challenges within a collaborative, supportive and knowledge\-driven team. To further strengthen our programs and projects, we provide professional development opportunities and support special interest projects that can enhance the capability and services the Ecotoxicology team provides.  

  

**About You**  

You are a curious and motivated scientist with qualifications and experience in ecotoxicology, including ecotoxicity testing, data analysis and interpretation. You enjoy solving complex environmental problems with scientific rigour and are comfortable working independently or as part of a team. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and effective communication skills will enable you to thrive in this role and contribute to protecting the environment for future generations.  

  

**Essential Requirements**
* Scientific qualifications, knowledge and demonstrated experience in ecotoxicology science including ecotoxicity methods, analysis and interpretation.

  


For more information read the full Role Description: **Scientist (Ecotoxicology)**  

  

**About the Team – Science \& Insights**  

Science \& Insights sits within the **NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW),** which works to protect the state’s environment and heritage while driving a sustainable future for NSW.  

  

Working at the intersection of science, policy and delivery, Science \& Insights collaborates across government, academia, industry and communities to identify priority issues and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions.  

  

The division brings together six specialist branches spanning conservation and restoration, climate and atmospheric science, environmental protection, remote sensing and landscape science, science impact and assessment, and water, wetlands and coastal science.  

  

Together, these teams provide the evidence, expertise and insights needed to understand NSW’s environment, manage risks and drive sustainable outcomes.  

  

The division’s work is focused on building a strong evidence base, advancing innovation in how data is gathered and used, and translating complex scientific information into clear, actionable insights and advice. Through scientific rigour, partnerships and knowledge sharing, Science \& Insights plays a critical role in protecting, restoring and strengthening the resilience of NSW’s environment for future generations.  

  

**Who we are**  

The Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW) works to protect the state’s environment and heritage. It leads the way on climate change, driving the sustainable transition to a net zero economy, powered by affordable, reliable, and clean energy.  

  

DCCEEW conserves and protects the state’s natural environment. It manages the NSW national park estate, including its rich and diverse biodiversity and Aboriginal cultural heritage for future generations.  

  

DCCEEW also ensures sustainable management of water resources across the state, to support the environment, communities and industry.  

  

We acknowledge the ongoing custodial responsibilities of the Aboriginal peoples of NSW to care for Country and water and are committed to establishing meaningful partnerships with Aboriginal peoples in the management of the environment.  

  

**To Apply**  

If excited by the information above, we look forward to receiving your application, including a copy of your resume (maximum three pages) and cover letter (maximum two page) expressing your interest and suitability for the role.  

  

Please note to be eligible to apply for this position you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or permanent resident, or hold a valid Australian working Visa for the duration of the appointment.  

  

**Applications close 13 September 2026 at 11:55PM.**

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking a highly experienced **Client Account Manager/Senior Project Manager \- Environmental Compliance focused** with expertise in environmental health \& safety compliance and account management to support business growth and client engagement. This role is ideal for a proven sales leader with an existing book of clients, strong relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of environmental compliance strategies. The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing new business opportunities, driving revenue growth, and delivering innovative environmental solutions.


This hybrid position can be based out of AECOM's offices in Houston, TX; Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; Cincinnati, OH; Denver, CO; Fort Collins, CO; Minneapolis, MN; or Orange, CA. We are also open to candidates not located in these areas, however, must be located within the Western Region of the United States.

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Develop and execute business strategies to expand AECOM’s environmental compliance services.
* Maintain and grow existing client relationships while identifying new opportunities in the public and private sectors.
* Leverage an existing book of clients to generate sales and secure high\-value environmental projects.
* Work closely with internal teams to develop and present proposals, technical solutions, and service offerings.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements to align with client needs and financial objectives.
* Provide industry insight and stay updated on environmental regulations, compliance standards, and emerging trends.
* Support cross\-business collaboration to provide integrated environmental solutions across multiple sectors.
* Meet or exceed sales targets while contributing to the long\-term strategic vision of AECOM.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, engineering, business, or related field.
* 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in managing client accounts, sales and drive business development initiatives within environmental compliance services.
* Travel of 25\-50% will be required, as this is a client facing role.
* Valid US Driver's License and pre\-employment driving record verification are required.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree is highly preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in account management, sales, and environmental compliance services.
* Experience leading large\-scale environmental compliance projects.
* Strong understanding of environmental regulations, permitting, and compliance.
* Established industry relationships with clients in government, energy, commercial, and industrial sectors.
* Experience in contract negotiations, sales forecasting, and revenue management.
* Ability to work in a matrixed organization, coordinating across multiple teams and disciplines.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, data analytics, and sales tracking platforms.
